note: Full target inventory. FUNCTIONAL is not complete parity. Most entries remain NOT_STARTED.

capabilities.name: Persistent part and assembly desktop modeling workflow
capabilities.reference_behavior: A persistent desktop application provides model browsing, parameter editing, evaluated 3D geometry, undo/redo, native documents, and neutral-format export.
capabilities.expected_input: Create an extruded box, edit its width, cut a positioned hole, undo/redo, save/reopen, export STEP, then insert the current part into an assembly.
capabilities.expected_output: The OCCT B-rep regenerates after edits; browser and shaded viewport reflect the document; history and persistence restore exact tested model states; exported STEP is non-empty.
capabilities.performance: The tested small part and two-occurrence assembly regenerate interactively; large-model viewport performance is not yet characterized.
capabilities.evidence: Implemented in the Mechanical Qt desktop and exercised by mydesk_mechanical_gui_tests.
capabilities.differences: No interactive constrained sketcher, face/edge picking, complete feature-dialog set, drawing environment, hierarchical assembly editing, or accelerated OCCT selection context. This is a substantive workflow slice, not full Inventor UI parity.

capabilities.name: Rectangle sketch + extrude solid with regeneration
capabilities.reference_behavior: A rectangular sketch driven by width/height parameters extrudes to a B-rep solid. Editing an upstream parameter and regenerating updates the solid volume.
capabilities.expected_output: Solid volumes 240 then 288; STEP export non-empty; feature history reloads
capabilities.performance: Regeneration of this feature is interactive.
capabilities.differences: The tested rectangle/extrude, parameter regeneration, native round-trip, and STEP output work. Inventor's sketch constraint system, feature options, reference selection, units and error recovery are not fully matched.

capabilities.name: Cylindrical hole boolean cut on solid
capabilities.reference_behavior: Parametric cylindrical hole cut with radius, depth, and 2D position subtracted from base solid geometry using B-rep boolean cut. Volume updates on regeneration and persists through native format.
capabilities.expected_input: 10x10x10 block with r=2, depth=10 hole cut through center
capabilities.expected_output: Volume reduced by cylinder volume pi*r^2*h (~125.66); solid result preserved; STEP exportable
capabilities.performance: Interactive boolean subtraction via OCCT.
capabilities.differences: The tested cylindrical through-cut and persistence behavior work. Counterbore/countersink, tapped and clearance standards, termination modes, face-reference placement, and patterned holes are not fully matched.

capabilities.name: Assembly document, component occurrences, constraints, and BOM rollup
capabilities.reference_behavior: Multi-component occurrences placed and constrained via Mate and Insert constraints. Solves 3D transforms, rolls up hierarchical BOM entries with unit/total volumes, and outputs compound STEP assembly.
capabilities.expected_input: Two blocks and a spacer; mate and insert constraints
capabilities.expected_output: Occurrences solved at target 3D coordinates; BOM lists occurrence counts and volumes; compound STEP exported
capabilities.performance: Interactive constraint solving and compound shape generation.
capabilities.differences: Occurrence placement, simple coordinate constraints, BOM rollup, native restoration, and compound STEP export are tested. General face-reference constraint solving, degrees-of-freedom diagnostics, and hierarchical subassemblies are not implemented.

capabilities.name: Joints and motion
capabilities.reference_behavior: Rigid, revolute, and slider joints constrain occurrence motion along a normalized axis, enforce travel limits, update component transforms, and preserve driven positions in the assembly document.
capabilities.expected_input: Grounded base plus arm and carriage occurrences; a -90..90 degree revolute joint and 0..15 mm slider joint
capabilities.expected_output: Bounded transforms applied to the actual OCCT occurrence B-reps, undo/redo of joint drive edits, and complete native round-trip
capabilities.performance: Linear pass over joints and occurrences for the tested single-level assembly subset.
capabilities.differences: Single-level global-axis rigid/revolute/slider kinematics are implemented. Hierarchical local-coordinate composition, inferred joints, contact sets, dynamics, and motion studies are not implemented.
